answer.reason: Several verses tell events that happened in or to Moab: its king hiring Balaam, the death of Moses there, and its defeat under Ehud.

clauses.english: sent for Balaam to curse Israel
clauses.quote: sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you

clauses.english: was where Moses died and was buried
clauses.quote: Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab

clauses.english: lost ten thousand men and was subdued under Israel
clauses.quote: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel.

doubts: The marked verses naming Hadad who smote Midian in the field of Moab, Shaharaim, Ithmah and Jokim only mention Moab as a place or origin, so they were left out.
Many marked prophecies against Moab (Isaiah, Jeremiah, Amos, Zephaniah) were left out because they foretell and do not state events that happened.
Other events (Moab under David, the revolt against Israel, the war with Jehoshaphat) were passed over to keep the line short.
